To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Internet of the future will be a multi-layered architecture with a backbone and a number of device networks, and with a standard secure API for service provisioning and interconnection.

(i) the architecture for the IoT is structured into a backbone network, separate device networks and a secure API; (ii) the API decouples innovation in the service logic from protocols, network elements and devices; (iii) the API enables service portability and service replication, and supports ubiquitous service provisioning; (iv) the API is designed to be secure and scalable and supports multi-homing, mobility and persistent storage; and (v) the API is extensible to cater for new services
the proposed architecture enables a secure, flexible, and scalable service platform for IoT, and that the API is the key enabler.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, analysis, prototyping and evaluation of a new architecture and protocols to enable the Internet of Things.
architecture, security, and protocols for the IoT.
the architecture of the Internet of Things and how to provide ubiquitous services in this environment, with a particular emphasis on the security and privacy aspects.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the architecture is a significant improvement over existing approaches, and that it is a major contribution towards the Internet of Things.
the proposed architecture is a step towards a truly open and interoperable IoT.
this is the most complete and detailed proposal for the IoT architecture.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have designed an architecture for IoT that enables ubiquitous services, with service portability, and that is secure, scalable and efficient.
we have designed and implemented the architecture and its components, and demonstrated the feasibility of the architecture by means of a number of use cases.
it is a novel, comprehensive, and practical architecture for the IoT.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Internet is not ready for the IoT.
the Internet of Things requires a novel architecture that supports the required functionality, and the proposed architecture is a step in the right direction.
a single architecture can cater for the entire range of IoT applications, from simple to complex and from small to large, and from simple devices to complex end systems.
